status: Figure 7: observed shape agreement with matched native NISP contours

settings.contours: Native-versus-JWST joint density, separately for e1 and e2 on the fixed-estimator common sample. Gaussian KDE with Scott bandwidth; 401x401 uniform grid over [-2,2] in both axes. Highest-density contours enclose 68% and 95% of integrated grid probability; same density and levels reused in every column. Display limits [-1,1].
settings.gain: 100*(1-RMSE_method/RMSE_native), on identical objects; positive means improvement, negative means degradation. Paired spatial-block 95% intervals with 2000 draws, seed 20261017.
settings.population: All 2118 frozen validation objects attempted. Per-estimator intersection of successful JWST, native NISP, and all six cached methods; same objects in every model panel. Also report the intersection across both estimators and full-denominator failure counts.
